info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Facility Property Portfolio-spec
info.description: This API enables the creation and management of facility property portfolios within the banking sector. Users can initiate the setup of new property portfolios, which serve as a grouping of facilities for effective management and tracking. Typical consumers include financial institutions and property managers who need to organize their property assets strategically. The API allows for streamlined portfolio creation to enhance operational efficiency and support decision-making processes in property management.

post.summary: Create a new property portfolio within facilities.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new property portfolio in the facilities management system. By providing the necessary details, you can manage your properties effectively, enhancing your portfolio's organization and accessibility.
